title: RPG Maker MZ winch+chain sprite request

posts.author: UnusualPotato
posts.body:
Hello, I'd like to request a sprite of a winch with a chain for my personal Call Me Kevin (a YouTuber) fangame.
Resource Type:
Sprite sheet/tile
Maker Format:
MZ
Makers I Own:
VX Ace, MV, MZ
Art Style:
MZ RTP
Description:
I'm imagining a winch with a crank, the kind you might find on a fishing boat. The area of the game it will be found in is an ancient underwater temple inhabited by fishmen, though they were quite skilled metalurgists and engineers. The body of the crank would be made out of two light blue-tinted stone slabs on a stand, with a bar connecting them. On the bar would be rolled a gray metal chain extending upward beyond the map area. It would be turnable with a wooden crank, which would move the chain and roll/unroll it from the bar. Obviously, this movement would be animated through a spritesheet. It would need to have several states, based on the position of the crank and the length of the chain still on the bar. The entire sprite would be viewed with the crank facing you, e.i. the bar would be oriented vertically. Fyi, the chain would control a large metal gate.
Reference Images:
There really aren't many that are accurate, but I tried my best to find some. The actual sprite would need to have more sharp edges and an actual crank, besides being made out of the correct material ofc.

posts.author: UnusualPotato
posts.body: Replying to bump. I understand it might be a bit much to ask for, but even some kind of base to work with would be very helpful.
